totonoeLog.copyMasked.maskTimestamp.desc: Mask timestamps when running Totonoe Log: Copy Masked Text.
totonoeLog.copyMasked.maskHost.descripti: Mask IPv4/IPv6 addresses and hostname tokens on lines recognized as syslog when running Totonoe Log: Copy Masked Text. This does not mask arbitrary hostnames in every format.
totonoeLog.copyMasked.maskProcessId.desc: Mask process IDs when running Totonoe Log: Copy Masked Text (the syslog form sshd[1234]: and explicit pid labels such as pid=1234). This is also the initial value for the mask panel in the Interactive View.
totonoeLog.collapse.threshold.descriptio: The minimum number of consecutive repetitions that Totonoe Log: Show Interactive View collapses into one line when repeated-line collapsing is enabled.
totonoeLog.gap.thresholdSeconds.descript: Insert an 'XX seconds of silence' separator line in the views produced by Totonoe Log: Open in Virtual Document when the timestamp gap between consecutive entries is at least this many seconds. It is recalculated after filtering. Set to 0 to disable.
totonoeLog.interactiveView.maxDisplayLin: The maximum number of lines Totonoe Log: Show Interactive View renders at once. Beyond this, only the leading lines are shown and a notice suggests opening the whole log with Export as Virtual Document. Set to 0 to disable.
totonoeLog.timezone.display.description: The timezone used to display timestamps in every view. Specify 'UTC', 'local' (this machine's local timezone), or a UTC offset such as '+09:00'. Non-UTC values are displayed with an offset (for example, 2024-01-02T12:04:05.000+09:00).
totonoeLog.timezone.sourceOffset.descrip: The UTC offset to assume when interpreting timestamps without timezone information (for example, 2024-01-02 03:04:05). This does not affect timestamps with an explicit offset or Z, or epoch formats.
totonoeLog.timezone.fileOffsets.descript: Override `totonoeLog.timezone.sourceOffset` by file name pattern to correct per-server timezone differences when merging. Rules are evaluated from top to bottom; the first match wins.
totonoeLog.timezone.fileOffsets.filePatt: A regular expression matched against the file's base name (without its path).
totonoeLog.timezone.fileOffsets.offset.d: The UTC offset to apply (for example, '+09:00').
totonoeLog.clockSkew.fileOffsets.descrip: Shift timestamps in logs from hosts with skewed clocks by ±N seconds, according to file name pattern. This applies to every recognized timestamp regardless of timezone notation; merged and normalized views use the corrected times. Rules are evaluated from top to bottom; the first match wins.
totonoeLog.clockSkew.fileOffsets.filePat: A regular expression matched against the file's base name (without its path).
totonoeLog.clockSkew.fileOffsets.offsetS: The correction to apply in seconds. Use a negative value (for example, -40) for a host whose clock is ahead.
totonoeLog.timestampFormats.description: Add timestamp formats the built-ins do not recognize, using regular expressions with named capture groups. Custom formats are tried before built-ins. Calendar formats must include `y`, `mo`, `d`, `h`, `mi`, and `s` groups, with optional `ms`, `tzs`, `tzh`, and `tzm`; epoch formats must include `epochMs` or `epochSec`, with optional `ms`. See 'Custom timestamp formats' in the README.
totonoeLog.timestampFormats.name.descrip: The display name for this format. Defaults to custom-<number> when omitted.
totonoeLog.timestampFormats.pattern.desc: A regular expression that matches a timestamp at the beginning of a line (it is automatically anchored to the start). Use named capture groups to specify how to parse it.
totonoeLog.highlightRules.description: Register keywords or patterns to emphasize in the Interactive View. Only matched text is colored; lines are not removed as they are by filtering. Patterns are interpreted as case-insensitive regular expressions. See 'Highlight rules' in the README.
totonoeLog.highlightRules.name.descripti: The display name used to distinguish this rule in settings and warning messages. Defaults to highlight-<number> when omitted.
totonoeLog.highlightRules.pattern.descri: A regular expression that matches text to color (case-insensitive). Every match within a line is colored.
totonoeLog.highlightRules.color.descript: The color. Values are chosen to remain readable in both light and dark themes. Defaults to yellow when omitted.
